svg.title: I-ITSM | Priority and technician assignment strategies

g.text: I-ITSM | Priority and technician assignment strategies
+configure(assignment: String, priority: String, p1: double, p2: double, p3: double, email: boolean) : void
+assign(i: Incident, technicianId: Long, actor: User, reason: String) : void
+result(score: double, s: SystemSettings, reason: String) : Result
Priority keys: WEIGHTED and RULE. Assignment keys: SKILL and LOAD.
Strategies are injected and selected by SystemSettings at runtime.
Candidate.eligible requires active, available and workload below capacity.
There is no IncidentStrategy class: the two actual interfaces are shown.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
